text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 242 (F-c7me), made on the native images with Graesse's edition of the Legenda aurea (2nd ed., 1850, pp. 662-665, 685-688) at hand. Reread on the image: canvas 0 right page lines 1-12, left page lines 1-11 and 24-33; canvas 1 left page lines 1-9 and 14-23, the visible pieces of the right page, two turned-in strips and one printed piece. Other lines are not given here and rest on the image-only first reading. Regions x,y,width,height in native pixels. ( ) expansion; [ ] lost, covered or supplied; ? uncertain.
